conditioningLevel.rationale: Rich architecture: prominent payload lipid Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil (6) converging with prominent Amodimethicone (9) and cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (10) is W-RICH, which counts as a rich architecture for conditioning (Section 5, W-RICH); plus waxy Hydrogenated Castor Oil (11) and Glycol Distearate (14). C2 itself is not met (no deliberate humectant route; Hexylene Glycol does not count).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Missing humectant element; oil and silicone levels bounded by position after Sodium Chloride. Moderate is the realistic neighbor.

depositionLoad.rationale: Argan oil (6), Amodimethicone (9), guar (10), Hydrogenated Castor Oil (11), Coconut Acid (12): oil + amino-silicone + cationic + waxy lipid converge, all prominent.

persistence.rationale: Amodimethicone is substantive; waxy HCO more persistent than liquid oil; guar aids deposition.

resetCapacity.rationale: C6 low chassis (taurate/glucoside/betaine), no strong anionic: limited reset.
